newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan shareholders nod 96 dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: Changan shareholders nod 96 dividend plan.

text.p: Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd said on Tuesday its shareholders had approved a cash dividend plan for holders of its B shares and institutional shares based on 1996 results.
The company said in a statement in Tuesday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times that it would make a cash payment of 0.03025 yuan per B share and 0.20506 yuan per share held by state institutions.

The dividend for B shareholders is paid in Hong Kong dollars at an exchange rate to be announced later. Four shareholders representing 631.19 million shares, or 72.04 percent of Changan's 876.19 million outstanding shares passed the proposals, the statement said.
The plans are subject to the final approval of securities regulators, the company said. It gave no further details.
Changan, one of China's biggest auto makers, posted a net profit of 202.83 million yuan for 1996 against 220.16 million yuan for 1995 under international accounting standards.

The company, based in the city of Chongqing in southwestern Sichuan province, listed 250 million B shares on the Shenzhen bourse in late 1996 and 83 million A shares earlier this month, also in Shenzhen.
